unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #343 "Add a Nano (XNO) settlement rail — zero network fee and no facilitator fee-payer for agentic micro-payments" on solana-foundation/pay-kit. Argued the kit already sells no-middleman/micro-tx/no-account, and Nano removes the last costs the Solana rail keeps: the network fee and the x402 facilitator-as-fee-payer. Offered to sketch verify-and-replay against any SDK.
